topbar.condutaTooltip: Conduct is public on FormulaDota — accountability is a principle, not an option. Read the Code before your first match.

capa.subtitle: Dota is one of the best games in the world. What's broken is Valve's competitive environment — even the legends are leaving. Here, the culture has rules.
capa.pillarAnonimatoLine: Public name, reputation attached. No mask, no smurf, no running from the consequences.
capa.pillarMmrLine: Every cycle restarts from zero. #1 becomes reachable again — even for whoever just arrived.
capa.pillarRegiaoLine: A single race, no borders. The best is the best in the world — not “the best in your region”.
capa.doctrineBody: here every player masters the fundamentals of the Fórmula do Dota de Corrida — the same doctrine, the same expectations, everyone in the same game.
capa.pulso: {count, plural, =0 {No PRO in queue right now} =1 {# PRO in queue right now} other {# PROs in queue right now}}

shell.newsDescription: Buy tokens, play an official ranked match with a Fórmula PRO. Either you win, or you learn.
shell.firstRuleBody: It's never the other guy's fault. The responsibility is always yours, 100% of the time.
shell.pendingRequestsTooltip: {count, plural, =1 {1 friend request received} other {# friend requests received}} — open the friends panel to respond.
shell.permissionsTooltip: Match permissions: {count} correct answers in the doctrine quiz = 1 permission. They stack — each match in any mode spends 1.
shell.pendingSuffix: ({count, plural, =1 {# pending request} other {# pending requests}})
shell.fichasTooltip: 1 token = 1 slot in a match with a PRO · R$ 10. One-off purchase via PIX.

playMenu.competitivaDesc: Automatic role-based matchmaking is coming soon. For now, play via Ranked with PRO or Custom Rooms.
